detail.description: AVideo是一个视频分享平台。在 8.1.0 中进行初始修复尝试之前，“objects/functions.php”中的“url_get_contents”仅在“FILTER_VALIDATE_URL”语法验证后接受调用者控制的目标，而不拒绝私有、环回或链接本地地址，并禁用 TLS 对等验证。 `Login::isLogged` 使用攻击者可设置的 `encoder_aVideoURL` cookie 以及任意非空的 `encoder_user` 和 `encoder_pass` cookie 重新进行身份验证，并且 `Login::run` 将原始获取的主体存储在 `result` 中。未经身份验证的“objects/login.json.php”端点返回该会话对象，从而通过提供的“siteURL”实现完整响应渗透；当操作员白名单为空（默认情况下）时，其“Streamer::isURLAllowed”门允许所有站点。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可以读取内部 HTTP 和 HTTPS 响应，包括云实例元数据凭据，并访问内部 TCP 服务。 `view/youtubeDl.json.php` 中的进一步预身份验证 FTP 变体将 ftp `videoURL` 路由到 `FTPDownloader` 中； `objects/FTPDownloader.php` 中的 `parseFtpUrl` 接受其主机和端口用于 `ftp_connect`。这也允许对内部 FTP 服务的请求。接受不受信任的自签名 HTTPS 证书，无需帐户或操作员交互。版本 8.1.0 包含初始修复尝试，删除原始响应反射并添加目标检查，但专用网络豁免和登录 TLS 验证默认设置使所描述的内部网络和 TLS 变体的完整修复尚未解决。
detail.title: CVE-2026-61572 漏洞

detail_original.description: AVideo is a video-sharing Platform. Before the initial remediation attempt in 8.1.0, `url_get_contents` in `objects/functions.php` accepts caller-controlled destinations after only `FILTER_VALIDATE_URL` syntax validation, without rejecting private, loopback, or link-local addresses, and disables TLS peer verification. `Login::isLogged` reauthenticates using the attacker-settable `encoder_aVideoURL` cookie together with arbitrary nonempty `encoder_user` and `encoder_pass` cookies, and `Login::run` stores the raw fetched body in `result`. The unauthenticated `objects/login.json.php` endpoint returns that session object, enabling full-response exfiltration through a supplied `siteURL`; its `Streamer::isURLAllowed` gate allows all sites when the operator allowlist is empty, the default. An unauthenticated remote attacker can read internal HTTP and HTTPS responses, including cloud instance-metadata credentials, and reach internal TCP services. A further pre-authentication FTP variant in `view/youtubeDl.json.php` routes an ftp `videoURL` into `FTPDownloader`; `parseFtpUrl` in `objects/FTPDownloader.php` accepts its host and port for `ftp_connect`. This also enables requests to internal FTP services. Untrusted self-signed HTTPS certificates are accepted, and no account or operator interaction is required. Version 8.1.0 contains an initial remediation attempt that removes raw-response reflection and adds destination checks, but private-network exemptions and login TLS-verification defaults leave complete remediation of the described internal-network and TLS variants unresolved.
